lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance circular clusters arranged in roughly vertical columns on the mid-lateral flank, with density increasing toward the dorsal-lateral boundary.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with circular high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature oriented horizontally across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with higher intensity on the dorsal side and a shadow-cast boundary on the ventral side.
